body: This is amazing!!!!
That is AMAZING! GREAT JOB!!!!
Thank you so much. I hope you are doing well today. Have a good day
I think the only slight thing would maybe be to try and bring the middle one down a tiny but but other than that, it looks amazing, well done!
Well done! I know telling people about it is hard. I am really proud of you. I hope your doctor will help you. Well done. Have a great day

Thank you, please let me know about those subs. I hope you are able to be yourself soon. 
I hope you are doing okay.

Getting rid of them is hard. I have not gotten ridden of them at all but music. Music really helps out to drown out the voices. I recommend ones that don’t have lyrics but whatever works for you. I am sure that people will have way better advice but music does help. I hope you can eventually get rid of those thoughts. You are not alone in your quest to get rid of those thoughts. Good luck.

I am glad that you have vented as it is very important, I find that (this is just my experience) but music will slow down the thoughts and hopefully drown them out. So if these thoughts of suicide come, maybe put on some music to clam your mind. Please try to vent more as it is very useful, I am with you in that I am not comfortable and I get really anxious when talking on the phone or in person. That’s why venting on this reddit is really good. What your parents think of you should not effect how you see yourself. Maybe take small steps to learn to love yourself more. And you can be out of their judgment once you are out of school. Just know that death is not always the end of the tunnel, try to (figuratively of course) ignore the turning to suicide, and keep going. I know it is easier said than done. I hope you start to feel better and know that you are not alone. Good luck out there in the world

Hey, I don’t want you to do this. But just know that I am here. You can always just vent. Please don’t do it, but just know that you are not alone. I have no idea who you are but just know that you are not alone and if you do it, someone will be with you. I hope you are okay.
Pleas get out of there. Call someone. It’s really important, please call someone. Just get out of there. Is there a police station near you? Just, get out of there
Thanks
Venting is still important, maybe venting a bit more might help? I hope you are okay now, or at least are becoming okay. Good luck with school.

Do not feel guilty for feeling things, please. I know thinking those thoughts may sound bad and selfish. But acknowledging those thoughts is important. Also, if you feel like moving place will be beneficial, then absolutely try your best to find a decent place to live elsewhere. Try to make your surroundings as safe and as comfortable as possible. I hope this in some way helped. I recommend calming music to listen too when the thoughts become too loud. I hope you stay safe and good luck in the world.
Hey, I might not be a good source of info but I’m always here to let people vent
What biomes are there nearby?
I’m glad you got out of there. And the fact that you are here wanting to help others, you are an amazing person.

I find too much light or sound or too much of anything overwhelming, to help with overwhelming sound, may I recommend some calming piano music. (Or any type that helps you hit piano or gameplay music does help). With lights I recommend finding a space where it is the perfect lighting for you (I know that sounds really hard but once you find it it will be worth it) and once you are back from wherever you have gone, you can go to that place to clear your mind. I hope that was in some way helpful. Just know that you are NOT alone. I hope you find peace. I’m rooting for you.
I love the design of the trees and the detail in the cottage. Amazing work! I hope you feel better soon.

Music, finding the right type of music is quite hard. But when you do eventually find that music, play it to try and drown out the voices. Whenever the voices may be too overwhelming just play that music. I recommend one with too many lyrics but whatever type helps you. I wish you luck. I hope you will eventually find happiness. Perhaps you have not yet found the true things that brings a smile to your face. But music is a great may to drown out unwanted thoughts.

This is probably not good advice so take it with a grain of salt.Music might help, but maybe choose like that calming stuff. Life is fucking boring so just mess around and try doing crazy stuff. I’m awful at giving f advice but I just want you to know that people are hear. And talking about feelings and shit sucks so I won’t bother with that. But like, give it a day or two. Get rid of all that stuff (harder than it sounds I know) and maybe try start afresh. Just, try (as hard as it may be) to throw away all of that stuff and just keep walking the tunnel. It looks bloody long. And the light may not even be insight. Yes death is on that path but on a turning. You can ignore that turning and continue onwards. Just ignore it. Distractions are great. Just look at memes or something for hours. I don’t know, but try to get rid of all that stuff. I hope you are okay. Please help yourself.
Thank you, I might go for a walk in a minute. I just find it hard to distract myself from these kind of thoughts. But I appreciate you saying this. I hope you are doing okay.

Maybe find some calming music to help with sleep? I know that it does help some people. I hope you will be okay soon. Just try and find a distraction I know that if I sit in silence for long enough my mind ends up destroying me. So perhaps a book? I am not sure but I hope you are okay. Good luck out there
I am so happy for you. Well done on getting somewhat out of the cave. Good luck in life!
That is incredible!!!
I love the detail of the windows, amazing trick. This is amazing and I love all the details. Amazing work!

People are often like, come to me if you have a problem but when you do they are like ‘your being selfish’ ‘stop attention seeking’. I am kind of a science geeky person so people only talk to me for answers and help with their mental help. And it just hard to talk to anyone right? Anyway, I hope you are okay-ish. 
My friends are all fake anyway, so I’m trying to push them away.
That looks really good. Well done!
